title: Grid soft-to-smoke contact graph bounded lifecycle

sources.rollback: docs/RESOURCE-LIFETIME.md: rejected graph mutations preserve the last usable graph

state_fingerprint: Graph SHA-256 combines the accepted descriptor with the public CONTACT-redirected predicate and dynamic soft-body invariance. Endpoint SHA-256 is a canonical public behavioral signature containing smoke tracer count and the same predicates. CONTACT-redirected means x at or behind -0.0145 m with no inward +X velocity. Raw public soft-body surface, node and smoke fields remain in each checkpoint probe for audit; exclude handles, timings and driver-private state.
observation_boundary: After every accepted mutation and the record-time capacity rejection, execute a fresh zero-gravity grid-smoke probe step and public soft/smoke readback under the surviving graph. Generation is the harness ordinal of an accepted graph mutation, never a private driver handle.
scope: SMOKE_GRID capacity, CONTACT replacement, removal and capacity-rollback only. Submit-time invalid endpoints remain pending by public API design, so this profile does not claim a direct post-rejection grid step; existing particle adverse lifecycle coverage retains the separate partial-rollback binding. API 0.2 groups CONTACT and DRAG in one descriptor; DRAG stays inert. A retained +X grid-smoke tracer must be reprojected by every active CONTACT checkpoint, move when the graph is removed, and be reprojected after recovery.
